cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: SME Brief serves small-business financial management for African SMEs operating across French and English language contexts, with domain-specific reasoning over invoices, contracts, supplier statements, and cash flow in XOF, USD, TZS and other local currencies. French is retained as the working language of Francophone commerce.

test_prompts.prompt: A small importing business in Tanzania has USD 50,000 in customer receivables and USD 30,000 in supplier debts. What three practical steps should the owner take this week to improve cash flow? Be specific and brief.

Rédigez un email poli en français à un fournisseur à Dakar pour demander une extension de paiement de 30 jours pour la facture FACT-2024-0042, suite à un retard temporaire de trésorerie de notre entreprise. Restez sous 120 mots.
